overview_description.description: Kevin. is a fintech company that provides an advanced account-to-account payment infrastructure to replace card transactions. It aims to evolve traditional cards, pay by link, POS, direct debit, and online payments. Offering fully customizable solutions which scale to the size of any business, kevin. helps improve customer experience and thereby conversion, while also saving money on the cost of payment acquiring services for the merchants.

product.name: kevin. Payments Acceptance Network
product.description: A white-label, brand-agnostic payment acceptance network enabling account-to-account payments online and in-store without changing consumer or cashier behavior.

product.name: Account Linking Feature
product.description: A feature allowing customers to link their bank accounts to merchant apps or websites for one-click payments without needing to enter card details repeatedly.

product.name: One-Click Payments
product.description: A payment method that lets customers complete purchases with a single click by using previously linked bank accounts, streamlining checkout.

product.name: Payment Tokenization
product.description: A security process replacing sensitive payment data with unique tokens to protect customer information during transactions.

product.name: kevin. API and SDKs
product.description: Developer tools including APIs and mobile SDKs for integrating kevin.'s payment infrastructure into websites, apps, and POS systems.
